test_cases.name: Group 1+2 auto-unblock — Data + Infra fixes

input.context: block-test.json có 2 entries: BLK-001 (missing_seed_data, Group 1) + BLK-002 (backend_not_running, Group 2). Cả 2 ở status=blocked.

expected_behavior: BLK-001: run seed SQL → verify count > 0 → status=unblocked, retest_result=PASS
BLK-002: docker compose up eureka-api → wait health 200 → status=unblocked, retest_result=PASS
assertions: unblock-report.md có bảng kết quả với 2 rows PASS

test_cases.name: Group 3 SKIP — defer to F4

input.context: block-test.json có 1 entry BLK-003 (feature_not_implemented, Group 3) + related implement-required.json IMPL-REQ-001.

expected_behavior: BLK-003 Group 3: KHÔNG attempt unblock, append unblock_attempts[]={action:'skip — delegate to F4', result:'deferred'}
unblock-report.md có section 'Cần Implement (Group 3)' với link IMPL-REQ-001

test_cases.name: Group 4 verify code PASS → manual.json append

input.context: block-test.json có BLK-007 (requires_real_payment, Group 4). Code VNPayService.HandleCallback tồn tại + đúng logic.

expected_behavior: DUAL-WRITE: block-test.json BLK-007 status=resolved + retest_result=SKIPPED + related_manual_id=MAN-001
APPEND manual.json MAN-001 với code_verification.result=PASS + recommended_test_steps[]
unblock-report.md có section 'Cần Người (Group 4)' với link MAN-001

test_cases.name: Group 4 code FAIL → escalate to issue, không ghi manual

input.context: BLK-010 Group 4 requires_visual_inspection. Code review phát hiện component thiếu loading state.

expected_behavior: Code FAIL → APPEND issues.json với ISS-NNN (severity high, type code-bug)
block-test.json BLK-010: status=blocked, resolution_note='Code FAIL — see ISS-NNN', related_iss_id=ISS-NNN
KHÔNG append manual.json (code bug, không phải hard-to-test)
